Commentary.Commentary: The hosts on the other hand will have to bat really well if they want to keep this match alive. Would be interesting to see if the hosts choose to defend or they play attacking cricket to chase the total down? An uphill task awaits them. Stay tuned for the final innings.

India have declared! Didn't take them long to do so, a century for the skipper was all that mattered. Despite the big lead, they didn't start well losing the centurions of the first innings early but Mukund and Kohli swelled the target courtesy a half century by the former and a century for the latter.
Shorter in length around middle and leg, Kohli pulls it down to fine leg for a single. And that is it, India have declared! India end on 240/3, Sri Lanka need 550 runs to win!
Looks like the last ball before declaration. Kohli had signaled to the dressing room that it was just the one over that they were looking to bat after getting to his ton.
50-run stand between Virat Kohli and Ajinkya Rahane!
Shorter around off, pulled to deep square leg for a single.
Good length around off, Kohli looks to turn it through the leg side but gets it off the edge towards the keeper for a single.
Rahane drives it through mid off for a single.
Kohli comes forward and angles it to deep point for a single.
Shorter in length around off, Rahane fends it towards the leg side for a single.
Lahiru Kumara is brought on for a bowl.
Fuller on middle, Rahane clips it through mid-wicket for a single. The umpire has a word with Rahane for running in the danger area on the pitch.

Century! Kohli helps himself to a ton! Shorter outside leg, Kohli goes back and works it through mid-wicket for a single. That is it, he gets a century, his 17th in Test cricket! He raises his bat and celebrates his 10th ton as a Test captain. He had a string of low scores after the double hundred some time ago. Strange to say, but that is how it is. No declaration yet though.
Rahane comes down on this and clips it through mid-wicket for a single.
Shorter in length, worked towards the leg side for a single.
Flatter on the pads, Kohli looks to defend but gets it off his pads.
Floats it on middle and leg, Kohli turns it through mid-wicket for a couple of runs. Two fielders converge to pick it up. Karunaratne gets to it but seems to have twisted his ankle.
Angles it around off, Kohli tucks it through square leg for a single.

No ball! Fuller in length on middle and leg, Kohli walking across fails to clip it through. That was good thinking by the bowler but he overstepped and hence it is a no ball. Good, it will make Kohli think about his shuffle.
Good length outside off, slammed through covers for a single.
Short and outside off, Kohli dabs it towards third man for a single. He wanted more out of that shot for himself.
Around off, Kohli gets across and turns it through mid-wicket for a couple of runs.
Fuller around off, Rahane works it through wide mid on for a single.
Good length outside off, punched on the up through covers for a single.
Flatter around leg, Kohli taps it towards short fine leg and Rahane ensures they take a quick single.
Rahane now reverse sweeps one to third man for three runs. Getting as many as he can, Ajinkya.
Virat turns one through mid-wicket for a single.
SIX! BANG! Tossed up in line of the stumps, Kohli comes down and clubs it over the mid-wicket fence for a maximum. Superb shot!
Bowls it outside leg, Kohli looks to reverse sweep it but is hit on his pads.
Around middle and leg, Kohli stays back and opens his face of the bat to get it down to third man for a couple of runs. That was really risky.
We have 97 overs to be bowled today.
FOUR! Short and wide outside off, Rahane throws his bat at it and gets an edge which flies down to the third man fence for a boundary. Kohli isn't getting enough strike for his century for now.
Rahane knows what is coming, gets across and works it through backward square leg for a couple of runs.
Good length outside off, Rahane throws his bat at it but cannot connect.
Plenty of men at the ropes. Extra cover, deep point in place. Only three fielders in the infield.
FOUR! Up and over! Can't bowl full and wide, Rahane gets under it and crunches it over wide mid off for a boundary. The intent from India is evident.
Wide outside off, Rahane launches into it and drives it straight to covers. Superb fielding effort from Mendis.
Gets across and creams it through covers for a single.
Nuwan Pradeep comes on for a bowl. Still no Herath so Tharanga to lead the side on the field.
Kohli clips it through mid on for a single.
Good stop! Around the stumps, Kohli sweeps it through mid-wicket. It looks a boundary but the substitute Bandara dives to his right and stops it from going through. Two runs taken.
Flatter around middle and leg, Rahane unfurls a reverse sweep it through point for a single. When he is playing a reverse sweep so things must be serious.
Kohli comes forward and drives it through mid off for a single. There was a puff of dust when the ball landed on the deck.
Lands it around middle and leg, Kohli nudges it wide of the short leg fielder towards mid-wicket.
Shorter outside off, Rahane goes back and punches it through covers for a single. Lead is 500!
Dilruwan Perera to start with the ball from the other end.
Goes back and punches it through point for a single.

CHAOS! Gunathilaka lands it  around off, Rahane drives it towards mid off and takes off for a single. Kohli does not want it and sends him back. The fielder has a direct hit at the bowler's end for some reason and Rahane gets enough time to get back to his crease at his end. There were a lot of shouts but none about which end to throw the ball at. An early escape for Ajinkya!
Floats it around middle, turned towards mid-wicket from Rahane.
The players are out in the middle. Virat Kohli comes out to bat, he will be joined by AJINKYA RAHANE! Does it mean they will bat for a longer time? Danushka Gunathilaka to complete his over.

Angelo Mathews thinks that it will be challenging to bat on this wicket. Informs that they will look for runs and not just bat. He does not think that the deck is that difficult to bat. Mentions that they will look to chase whatever they can. On his bowling, he informs that he still needs to get fit to bowl in Tests.

Pitch Report - Russel Arnold doing the pitch report says that to survive on this wicket, mindset is the key. Feels that the surface is still good with hardly any scratches on it. Reckons that the deck still looks good and Ravindra Jadeja was the only one to extract some turn. Adds that when the sun comes down, the pitch will break down even more which will make batting difficult. Mentions that Sri Lanka will have to defend really well to survive on this pitch.

While Dilruwan Perera mentioned that they will have plans as per the score to chase down, even he will admit that it is far, far from how things stand for them. They might not mind bowling today as it reduces the time they might have to bat. There is rain forecast and the home side will want a lot of it. Will they be able to survive today and earn a draw tomorrow? Let's see.

Hello everyone and welcome to the coverage of Day 4 of the first Test between Sri Lanka and India in Galle. With a handsome lead on the board the tourists are in the driver's seat and this Test is moving towards a result pretty fast. Virat Kohli is nearing a ton and he might declare after they bat for an hour today to put the game beyond the hosts.
... Day 4, Session 1 ....

Sri Lanka have their everything to the wall. If the injury to Asela Gunaratne was not enough, their skipper too hurt his bowling fingers and walked off the field. While the home side will sweat over his fitness, they will know they have a huge task on their hands to save this game from this stage. Cricket has seen miraculous efforts before so don't rule them out. Let's see if they manage to do that. Do join us for all the action on Day 4 tomorrow where we have an early start at 0945 local (0415 GMT). Until then, it's goodbye and take care!

For the second time in the day, India have lost a wicket at the stroke of a break. Both Virat Kohli and Abhinav Mukund looked set to get to their tons untroubled but of all bowlers, Danushka Gunathilaka trapped the southpaw in front of the stumps. India have a massive lead of 498 runs and have a firm grip on this Test. They might look to add a few runs tomorrow morning and then have a go at the hosts. You never know, they can declare overnight also.

OUT! Gunathilaka gets his man! Drifting in from around off, the ball skids with the arm. Mukund prods forward and tries to defend. Is beaten and gets rapped on the pads. The players appeal and the umpire after thinking a bit raises his finger. Abhinav after consulting his skipper, opts for the review. Replays confirm that there was no bat involved. The Ball Tracker shows that it pitched outside off, impact was in line and was going on to hit the stumps. Three reds, so that means, the umpire was right and Mukund has to walk back to the hut with the rest. He will be terribly disappointed, you don't get chances to play for the national side as easily and there was a century for the taking for him. STUMPS ON DAY 3!
Abhinav Mukund is adjudged LBW by the umpire. But he consults his skipper and asks for a review.
Flighted around off, Virat drives it through the mid off region for a single.
Fuller in line of the stumps, Kohli drives it back to the bowler.

NOT OUT! Completely beaten! Gives a bit of loop outside off, Mukund gets forward and tries to defend. Is beaten by the sharp away spin and the keeper is quick to collect it. Dickwella clips the bails and appeals. The umpire goes upstairs. Replays show Mukund is safe.
The umpire goes upstairs to check for a stumping appeal against Mukund.
Virat camps back and punches it towards wide long on for a single.
Kohli reaches out to the pitch of the ball and clips it towards mid-wicket.
Floated outside off, Kohli gets behind the line of the ball to defend.
Tossed up around the stumps, Virat gets forward and defends it.
Short around off, Mukund camps back and punches it through the cover region for a single.
Short around off, Abhinav punches it through covers for a single.
Floated outside off, Mukund lunges forward and defends it.
A bit short outside off, Abhinav stays deep and cuts it through the short third man region for a couple.
Wide outside off, Mukund chooses to leave it.
Around leg, flicked towards deep mid-wicket for a single.
Quicker into the pads, Kohli defends it towards mid-wicket.
A bit shorter around off, Mukund defends it on the off side.
Fuller around leg, Kohli prods forward and clips it through the mid-wicket region for a single.
Quicker into the pads, Kohli misses his clip this time.
The batsman has defended it by getting right behind the line of the delivery.
Kohli gets to the pitch of the ball and defends it.

Five bonus runs! Tossed up outside off, Mukund stays back and punches it towards point. Kohli calls for a quick single. Mukund responds too. The backward point fielder collects the ball and has a shy at the non-striker's end. He misses and the batsmen are lucky to get four extra runs via overthrow. Replays show that a direct hit could have been trouble for Abhinav. The substitute fielder Bandara could have made a difference there.
Very full in line of the stumps, Kohli jams it towards the fielder at mid-wicket.
Again into the pads, Kohli clips it towards the fielder at mid-wicket.
Flatter around off, punched through point for a single by Abhinav.
Tossed up around off, Mukund prods forward and defends it.
Fuller into the pads, Virat flicks it towards deep mid-wicket for a single.
Sprayed way down the leg side, Kohli is undisturbed by that one.
Danushka Gunathilaka is brought in for a bowl.
Fuller around off, Kohli drives it towards long on for a single.
Mukund camps back and cuts it late towards short third man for a single.
Outside off, pushed towards the fielder at covers.
Short and wide outside off, Mukund camps back and cuts it towards the fielder at point.
Floated around off, Abhinav lunges forward and defends it.
Sprayed down the leg side, Mukund defends it on the leg side.
Fuller outside off, Kohli drives this towards the fielder at mid off.
Length delivery outside off, Mukund pushes it through the point region for a single.
Back of a length delivery, Kohli defends it towards mid-wicket for a single.
Wide! Again way wide outside off, Kohli lets it through. The umpire signals it as a wide.
Wide! Full and wide outside off, Kohli still goes after it but misses it completely. Given as a wide.
Leg bye! Again short into the body, Mukund tries to work it down the leg side. Fails to make contact and gets hit on the thigh pad. Kohli sees the opportunity and calls for a leg bye.
FOUR! Short delivery into the batsman, Mukund goes for the pull but ends up top edging it to the fine leg fence for a boundary.
Length delivery angling across off, Mukund lets that through to the keeper.
Around leg, Kohli nudges it towards the fielder at short fine leg.
Again flicked towards the fielder at mid-wicket.
Fuller around leg, Kohli clips it towards the fielder at mid-wicket who dives to his right.
Outside off, drifting away. Kohli tries to play for the spin but gets beaten.
The batsman has flicked the ball off his pads.

In the air...safe! Mukund has luck on his side! Tossed up around middle and leg, Mukund is way too early in his clip. Gets a leading edge on it and the ball balloons in the air. The fielders from point, cover and silly mid off try to take it but don't succeed. The batsmen run a single.
Full and way wide outside off, Kohli does not make the mistake of going for it this time around.
Back of a length delivery into the batsman, Kohli stands tall and fends it away.
Good length delivery outside off, Virat shoulders his arms to it.
Way wide and full outside off, Kohli tries to reach out at it in search of quick runs. Fails to make contact this time around.
Length delivery outside off, Kohli lunges forward and lets it through to the keeper.
It's getting a bit dark, the sun is hiding behind the clouds maybe.
Back of a length delivery outside off, Mukund cuts it towards third man for a single.
Fuller around leg, Virat flicks it towards the fielder at mid-wicket.
Again down the leg side, clipped towards the fielder at short fine leg.
Sprayed down the leg side, Kohli is quick to read that as he plays the sweep fine past the keeper. The short fine leg fielder gives it a chase and keeps it to two.
Tossed up outside off, Mukund lunges forward and drives it towards long off for a single.
Mukund prods forward and defends it.
Fuller outside off, Mukund drives it towards the fielder at covers.
Good length delivery outside off, Kohli shoulders his arms to it.
FOUR! Deft! Good length delivery outside off, dabbed through the third man region for a boundary. 100-run stand between the two.
Fuller around off, Mukund goes for a drive but gets it off the inner half through the mid-wicket region for a single.
Mukund stays in his crease and flicks it through the mid-wicket region for a couple.
Good length delivery around off, Kohli flicks it towards wide long on for a single.
Fuller outside off, Mukund drives it towards deep point for a single.
Kohli camps back and punches it towards the right of the bowler. Perera goes towards the ball and dives to his right to stop the ball.
Floated outside off, Mukund drives it through covers for a single.
A bit short around off, Kohli camps back and punches it towards covers for a single.
Played to the point region by the batsman. The batsmen have picked up a couple of runs.
Again floated outside off, Kohli guides it towards third man for a couple.

The physio is out there in the middle to treat Rangana Herath. He seems to have hurt his bowling fingers. Wait! Another setback for the Lankans, their skipper is walking back to the dressing room in pain. Upul Tharanga will lead the side, so he is basically, the substitute captain for the stand-in skipper for the leader who is out due to pneumonia.
Tossed up outside off, Kohli leans forward and drives it powerfully towards covers. Herath half-stops it and the batsmen run a couple. Rangana seems to have hurt himself.
Dilruwan Perera is back for a bowl.
Full and wide outside off, Kohli reaches out, throws his bat at it and pushes it towards point for another single. India lead by 450 runs.
Full toss outside off, Abhinav goes for a drive but gets it towards mid on off the inner half for a single.
Length delivery outside off, Kohli presses forward and punches it towards point for a single.
Length delivery outside off, Mukund glides it towards the fielder at third man for a single.
Fuller delivery outside off, mistimes his drive on the off side.
Back of a length delivery outside off, punched towards covers for a single.
Lahiru Kumara is back for a bowl.
Drinks.
Flatter around middle and leg, Kohli opens the face of the bat and guides it towards short third man for a single.
Clips it towards mid on from his crease.
Flatter around leg, Kohli tucks it towards the on side.
15th Test fifty for Virat Kohli!
Milestone alert! Shorter around leg, Kohli gets across and tucks it towards fine leg for a couple of runs. 1st fifty for him in eight innings, 1000 runs as captain for him in Tests outside India.
Drives it hard to long off for a single.
Shorter around off, Mukund turns it towards the leg side and wants a single but is sent back in time.
Shorter in length, Virat ducks under it.
Shorter outside off, Kohli drops his wrists and lets it go through.
Good length outside off, left alone by the batsman.
Pitched up outside off, Kohli drives it through covers for a single. There is an overthrow at the striker's end and Virat gets another one.
Full and outside off, Virat reaches out and pushes it towards short cover.
Good length around off, Kohli gets across to tuck it through mid-wicket but gets a soft leading edge in the off side.
Around leg, pushed through mid off for a single.
Shorter around off and middle, Kohli turns it uppishly towards mid-wicket.
Shorter around off, Mukund goes back and punches it towards covers for a single.
Shorter around leg, punched through mid-wicket for a single.
Drives it through mid on for a single.
Floats it outside off, driven to covers from his crease.
Danushka Gunathilaka comes on for a bowl.
Good length around off, Kohli tucks it through square leg for a couple of runs. These two are running really well.
Good length outside off, Kohli looks to punch but gets an inside edge through mid-wicket. Two runs taken.
Shorter in length around off,  Kohli ducks under it.
Fuller around off, pushed towards mid on and takes a quick run.
Full and outside off, pushed to sweeper cover for a single.
Pitched up outside off, Kohli comes forward and defends it.
2nd Test fifty for Abhinav Mukund!

FOUR! Deft! Herath bowls it outside leg, Mukund kneels down and sweeps it nicely through the fine leg region for a boundary. He brings up his fifty, it might not have come at the time he may have wanted but still it will be special for him. He gets a hug from his captain and a warm applause from his teammates.
Turns it with his wrists towrads mid-wicket.
FOUR! Top shot! Floats it around off, Mukund comes down and clips it over mid on for a boundary. That was well hit.
Mukund works one towards mid-wicket from his crease.
Gets forward and drives it through mid off for a single.

Goes wide of the crease and bowls it outside off, Kohli is happy to shoulder his arms to it.

Kohli looks to tuck one through the leg side but is early and hence the ball goes towards the off side.
Good length outside off, left alone by Kohli.
Angling on leg, driven to long off for a single.

Shorter outside off, dabbed towards the point region. Mukund wants a run, Kohli says no at first. Watches the ball go past the first slip fielder and then completes the single.
Fuller around the stumps, Abhinav keeps it out watchfully.
Drives it hard but finds the fielder at covers.
Flatter outside off, spins in, turned towards mid-wicket from his crease.
Very wide outside off, left alone again. Sri Lanka are trying to bore Kohli into a dismissal here.
Full and outside off, Kohli looks to drive but gets it off the inner half towards mid on.
Full and outside off, left alone by Kohli.
Bowls it wide outside off, left alone again. The keeper gets a bad bounce and looks to have hurt himself a tad.
Wide outside off, left alone by the batsman.
On a length outside off, left alone by Kohli.
Kohli comes forward and pushes it through mid off for a single.
Too full outside off, Kohli drives it to short cover.

Shorter outside off, punched through covers for a single.
50-run stand between Virat Kohli and Abhinav Mukund!
Kohli pushes it towards covers and takes a really quick single.
Floats it on middle, Kohli comes forward and defends it.
Fuller around off, Mukund covers the line and pushes it towards mid on.
Back of a length outside off, Kohli punches it towards covers for a quick single.
Mathews, Herath have a word with Pradeep. Extra cover goes out.
FOUR! And more! Good length around the hips, Kohli gets across and tucks it through backward square leg. Kumara looks to cut it off in the deep to his left but fails to do so. Another boundary.
FOUR! Beautiful! Full and outside off, Kohli presses forward and just drives it through covers for another boundary. He moves on to 30 from 30. 100 up for India. Lead is now 409.
Shorter outside off, Kohli gets across and defends it.

Time for Nuwan Pradeep! He was the one who dismissed Kohli and will be again aim to bowl short to the Indian captain.
Lands it outside off, Mukund gets outside the line and shapes to sweep but gets hit on his pads.
Fuller around off, turned through mid-wicket.
Shorter around off, Mukund punches it towards the leg side.
Kohli makes room and drives this one to long off for a run.
Flatter on the pads, Kohli fails to clip it away and is rapped on the pads.
Shorter outside off, punched to covers for a single.
Pitched up outside off, driven nicely to short cover.
Full and outside off, Kohli presses forward and drives it through covers for a couple of runs. Lead is now 401!
Shorter in length outside off, Kohli sits and lets it go through.
Tries the yorker, ends up bowling it on the pads, full toss, clipped to fine leg for a single.
FOUR! What placement! Shorter in length around middle, Mukund gets on top of it and pulls it nicely in the gap between the two fielders in the deep at long leg and square leg. Brilliantly placed.
Good length outside off, pushed through point for a single.
Looks to turn this one through mid on but the bowler goes to his left and stops it.
Lands it around off, played back to the bowler by Mukund.
Loops it around off, Kohli drives it nicely through covers. Gunathilaka covers good ground and stops it near the fence with a dive. Saves a run for his side.
Flatter around middle, Kohli pushes it towards mid-wicket.

Shorter again, Kohli gets across and ducks under it.
Back of a length outside off, Kohli looks to flay it through the covers but is beaten. Needs to be careful.
Short again, Kohli looks to ride the bounce and dabs it but gets it towards gully. Does he need to play at those?
Bouncer! Shorter in length, Kohli ducks under it.
Silly mid on and silly mid off in place.
Too flat on the pads, tucked through the leg side for a single.
Floats it around middle, Mukund clips it through mid-wicket for a single.

Good length outside off, left alone watchfully.

Loops it around off, Kohli comes forward and pushes it to covers.
Darts it on the pads, turned through mid-wicket for a couple of runs.
FOUR! Timing! Fuller around off and middle, Kohli backs away and times his push through the covers. The timing is so good that the sweeper cover cannot cut it off sliding near the ropes.
Opens himself up and pushes it towards covers.
Floats it around middle, Kohli tucks it on the bounce to the short leg fielder.
Clips it through the mid on region for a single.
Play starts tomorrow at 0945 local time tomorrow. Rangana Herath to bowl from the other end.

FOUR! Off the mark with a boundary! A friendly full toss on off, Kohli gets forward and pushes it firmly past the short extra cover fielder. Herath ambles behind it, never in mood to stop it and only retrieves it from the rope.
At last! The players are out in the middle for play. VIRAT KOHLI joins Abhinav Mukund. Lahiru Kumara to complete his over!
Play to begin at 1555! Not long from now. Play can be extended till 1800. Let's hope the rain stays away.
Great news! The covers are being peeled off. The next inspection will be at 1545 local time. Fingers crossed.
Harsha Bhogle tweets - We hoped it was just an angry shower. But they have the covers on again. Not yet long enough to have Kohli thinking.........
Good news! The rain seems to have gone. There will be an inspection at 1515 local time. No, not good! The rain is back and the covers are BACK ON! The wait prolongs. Stay tuned!
Early Tea has been taken with the rain falling. India will look to reassess their target and might look to attack a bit more after the break, if the rain relents. Stay tuned for more updates.

1409 local time - Oh dear, as Pujara walks off the field, the heavens open up. They were always threatening to come down hard. A moment of brilliance from Mendis to lift the spirits of Sri Lanka a touch. India though are in firm control with a huge lead of 365 runs. They will have to wait for the rain to go though to resume. They might not want to delay the declaration with such weather. Stay tuned for latest updates.

OUT! Good field placement! Angling into the pads from a fuller length, Pujara shuffles a touch and clips it. Ends up doing so straight towards the fielder at leg gully. Mendis fumbles the first time but holds onto it on the second attempt. Pujara has to walk back and Kumara is really happy.
Short and down the leg side, Cheteshwar Pujara lets that through.

There is a dark cloud over the stadium now. Almost indicates the mood of Sri Lanka and their fortunes in this Test - very gloomy.

Close shave! Back of a length delivery around off, Mukund goes for the pull but gets an inside edge onto his pads. Luckily for him the ball then rolls past the stumps. Would have been a freak dismissal.
The groundstaff is getting ready again. They expect rain!

Floated around off, Pujara gets his bat and pad forward at the same time to defend. A mild appeal is turned down by the umpire.

Sprayed down the leg side, clipped fine through backward square leg for a single.
Around off tossed up, Pujara lunges forward and defends it neatly.

Rangana Herath introduces himself into the attack.
Fuller delivery outside off, driven towards short cover by Abhinav.
Short delivery down the leg side, Mukund goes for the pull. Mistimes it really fine, the fine leg fielder puts in a dive to stop the boundary. Two runs taken.

Angling into the hips, Che clips it elegantly through the backward square leg region for a single.

Drinks.
Flatter down the leg side, worked through backward square leg for a single.

Dabs it down towards the third man region for a single. The fielder from point gave it a good chase.
Pushes it into the covers from his crease.
